Welcome to the WebCGM 2.1
Test Suite

(Release 1.2 -- 19 April 2010)

Note. The links to the dynamic10 tests, the 2.0 add-on test module, and the 2.1 add-on test module each go to a table of contents or index page, from which each of the individual tests will be linked. The link to the static-graphics (static10) tests goes to a JavaScript harness adapted from the NIST-ATA harness, which by the way will not work in older Netscape browsers. Please see the overview page for a general introduction and orientation to the test suite.
